FN-5ROL33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 137
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Artis 'A.J.'
McCampbell
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/14/2023
House Bill 137 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund and local funds by a small, undetermined amount by exempting the Black Belt Regional
Child Advocacy Center from paying state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes until
September 30, 2027.
